target_claim: The displayed clauses define a functor I_2 from (id_C ↓ C) to (id_C ↓ F).
source_quote:
:$I_2: \paren {\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow C} \to \paren {\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow F}$ defined by:
{{DefineFunctor
|ob = for each [[Definition:Object (Category Theory)|object]] $\tuple {E, g}$ in $\paren {C \downarrow F}$:
:$I_2 \tuple {E, g} = \tuple {E, *, g}$
|mor = for each [[Definition:Morphism (Category Theory)|morphism]] $k: \tuple {E, g} \to \tuple {E', g'}$ in $\paren{C \downarrow F}$:
:$I_2 k = \tuple {k, \operatorname{id}_*}$
